capabilities.notes: A local vault bridge must be explicitly supplied by the companion.
ChatGPT Work connectors are not the same as a local MCP client.
No local Agent Skills loader is assumed.
No Dex hook lifecycle is exposed by this descriptor.
Lifecycle is controlled by the ChatGPT product.
Dex cannot promise a local scheduler here.
Do not install a local plugin unless the client explicitly supports Agent Plugins v1.

limitations: This descriptor intentionally avoids promising local filesystem, MCP, or plugin parity.
name: ChatGPT Work companion
summary: A ChatGPT Work companion can provide a conversational front end, but local Dex vault and plugin loading are not assumed.
